description: This file defines the interface NoteService, which specifies methods for managing notes such as create, get by ID, get all, update, and delete, including owner scoping features.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Interface for managing notes with methods for create, retrieve, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Create a note for an optional owner.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieve a note by ID ensuring owner access where owner scoping is enabled.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieve all notes for owner if provided, or all notes if owner is null.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Update a note by ID with owner scoping.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete a note by ID with owner scoping.
